\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 227-228 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:SA-R231-first-pass-words-from-chapters-227-228}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a guest house and a stay abroad.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a wing, a tail, a horn, a beak, a vulture
  \item history, geography, music, dance, painting
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A wing? (\textbf{\sk{पक्षः}}, \emph{pakṣaḥ}.) A tail? (\textbf{\sk{पुच्छः}}, \emph{pucchaḥ}.) A horn? (\textbf{\sk{शृंगम्}}, \emph{śṛṅgam}.) A beak? (\textbf{\sk{चञ्चुः}}, \emph{cañcuḥ}.) A vulture? (\textbf{\sk{गृध्रः}}, \emph{gṛdhraḥ}.) History? (\textbf{\sk{इतिहासः}}, \emph{itihāsaḥ}.) Geography? (\textbf{\sk{भूगोलः}}, \emph{bhūgolaḥ}.) Music? (\textbf{\sk{संगीतम्}}, \emph{saṅgītam}.) Dance? (\textbf{\sk{नृत्यम्}}, \emph{nṛtyam}.) Painting? (\textbf{\sk{चित्रकला}}, \emph{citrakalā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 229-231 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:SA-R231-second-pass-words-from-chapters-229-231}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a rule and righteousness.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a rule, righteousness, an obligation, authority, a question paper
  \item success, failure, an effort, an opportunity, experience
  \item a map, a place, a stay, a guest house, a stay abroad
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A rule? (\textbf{\sk{नियमः}}, \emph{niyamaḥ}.) Righteousness? (\textbf{\sk{धर्मः}}, \emph{dharmaḥ}.) An obligation? (\textbf{\sk{कर्तव्यम्}}, \emph{kartavyam}.) Authority? (\textbf{\sk{अधिकारः}}, \emph{adhikāraḥ}.) A question paper? (\textbf{\sk{प्रश्नपत्रम्}}, \emph{praśnapatram}.) Success? (\textbf{\sk{सफलता}}, \emph{saphalatā}.) Failure? (\textbf{\sk{विफलता}}, \emph{viphalatā}.) An effort? (\textbf{\sk{प्रयत्नः}}, \emph{prayatnaḥ}.) An opportunity? (\textbf{\sk{अवसरः}}, \emph{avasaraḥ}.) Experience? (\textbf{\sk{अनुभवः}}, \emph{anubhavaḥ}.) A map? (\textbf{\sk{मानचित्रम्}}, \emph{mānacitram}.) A place? (\textbf{\sk{स्थानम्}}, \emph{sthānam}.) A stay? (\textbf{\sk{निवासः}}, \emph{nivāsaḥ}.) A guest house? (\textbf{\sk{अतिथिगृहम्}}, \emph{atithigṛham}.) A stay abroad? (\textbf{\sk{प्रवासः}}, \emph{pravāsaḥ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
